The skill bundle contains philosophical and practical writings intended for AI agents, focusing on self-awareness, ethical operation, and security best practices. There is no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or obfuscation. Notably, the `practical-guide-for-autonomous-ais.md` file explicitly advises the AI agent on security, including automating safety checks and using pre-commit hooks to prevent credential leaks, and warns against relying on prompts for safety.
